articles.title: Odisha H&UD dept to prepare plan for urban heatwave, flood management - The New Indian Express
articles.full_text:
H&UD additional chief secretary Usha Padhee Photo | X
BHUBANESWAR: The Housing and Urban Development department is set to work out a comprehensive action plan to tackle urban heatwave, and improve flood preparedness and stormwater drainage system in major cities and towns across the state.
A decision to this effect was taken during a high-level meeting chaired by H&UD additional chief secretary Usha Padhee. The meeting focused on preparing a coordinated and implementation-oriented framework for strengthening urban preparedness and resilience against rising temperature and flood-like situation.
Discussions were held on preparation of detailed project reports (DPRs), funding arrangements, capacity building, technical support and institutional mechanisms for implementation of the required measures. The focus was on all six municipal corporations as well as important major towns in other urban local bodies (ULBs), particularly areas requiring priority interventions.
During the meeting, Padhee stressed the need to bring all relevant stakeholders on board and develop a clear action plan with defined responsibilities and timelines for the purpose.
She emphasised the importance of identifying key stakeholders, including the Central Water Commission (CWC) and other expert agencies concerned and bringing them together on a common platform to improve flood preparedness in urban areas.
The H&UD ACS also called for identification of hotspots requiring immediate intervention for heatwave management in ULBs, along with a set of common interventions that can be undertaken across urban areas.
Padhee said the immediate objective should be to ensure that concrete interventions are in place to provide tangible relief to citizens before the next summer. At the same time, she called for systematic planning of medium and long-term measures to strengthen urban resilience.
Focus was laid on improving drainage system in the ULBs. The urban planning section of the department was asked to take up the issue of stormwater management on priority.
Padhee called for institutional mechanism for implementing stormwater action plans at ULB level to facilitate preparation of DPRs and provide the technical support required for effective implementation of the proposed interventions.
Among others, special relief commissioner (SRC) Rajesh Pravakar Patil and municipal administration director Arindam Dakua attended the meeting.

articles.full_text:
Sida loo ilaaliyo Makka Al Mukarrama iyo magaalooyinka kale ee barakaysan
Published
Waqtiga akhriska: 5 daqiiqo
Isbaheysiga ay Qaramada Midoobay aqoonsan tahay ee taageera dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay in ciidamada difaaca cirka ee Sacuudiga ay soo rideen diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn (drone) oo ay soo direen Xuutiyiinta, ka hor inta aysan soo gelin hawada sare ee magaalada barakeysan ee Maka.
Inkastoo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay beeniyeen sheegashooyinkaas, haddana tan iyo markii la baahiyay wararkaas, waxaa jiray dood xooggan oo ku saabsan awoodda iyo waxtarka nidaamyada difaaca cirka ee Sacuudiga, iyo sidoo kale nidaamka difaaca cirka ee ay Riyadh u isticmaasho ilaalinta Maka iyo magaalooyinka kale si looga hortago khatarta weerarrada.
Sacuudi Carabiya ma aysan shaacin nidaamka difaaca ee loo adeegsaday soo rididda diyaaradda aan duuliyaha lahayn ee la sheegay inay soo direen Xuutiyiintu, balse Wasaaradda Difaaca dalkaas ayaa bishii Maajo 2026-kii soo bandhigtay muuqaal muujinaya dhowr qalab oo gantaallada laga rido, nidaamka radar-ka, iyo qoryo waaweyn oo lid ku ah diyaaradaha.
Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in ciidanka difaaca cirka, ee isticmaala hubkaas, ay xil iska saarayaan "ilaalinta goobaha barakeysan iyo ka hortagga khatarta weerarrada cirka ee lagu qaadi karo goobahaas."
Laanta afka Urduuga ee BBC ayaa wareysatay Hamad Walid, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay cilmi baarista arrimaha milatariga iyo hubka, si ay u ogaato noocyada hubka uu Sacuudigu u isticmaalo ilaalinta hawadiisa, gaar ahaan ilaalinta goobaha barakeysan ee Islaamka.
Muxuu yahay qalabka difaaca cirka ee Sacuudigu haysto?
Hammad Walid, oo ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan Machadka Strategic Vision Institute oo ah xarun diiradda saarta cilmi-baarista hubka, ayaa u sheegay BBC Urdu in muuqaal ay Sacuudi Carabiya soo saartay bishii May ee sanadkan lagu arkay nidaamka difaaca hawada ee Patriot, iyo sidoo kale aaladaha gantaallada laga rido iyo raadaarrada uu sameeyo dalka Mareykanka.
Sida uu sheegay, bayaan rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa lagu sheegay in nidaamka Patriot la geeyay magaalooyinkan si loo ilaaliyo goobaha barakeysan sida Makka iyo Madiina.
Hammad Walid ayaa sidoo kale intaas ku daray in nidaamka qoryaha lidka ku ah diyaaradaha ee muuqaalka laga dhex arkay uu yahay nooca Oerlikon 35mm, kaas oo ay soo saartay shirkad laga leeyahay dalka Switzerland.
Intaas waxaa dheer, Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa bishii Maajo ee 2025-kii Mareykanka ka iibsatay nidaamka difaaca hawada ee THAAD, taas oo qayb ka ahayd dadaallada lagu xoojinayo difaaca hawadeeda.
Sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka ee dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya, xafladda lagu daah furayay nidaamka difaaca ayaa lagu qabtay Xarunta Ciidamada Difaaca Hawada ee magaalada Jeddah.
Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp.
Halkaan kaga soo biir
Dhamaadka xayeysiinta
Sida uu sheegay Hammad Walid, oo ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan Xarunta SVI, Sacuudi Carabiya waxay isticmaashaa nidaamka gantaallada ee Patriot si ay u soo riddo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones-ka) iyo diyaaradaha caadiga ah ee xamuulka qaada, iyo sidoo kale gantaallada nooca 'cruise' iyo gantaallada kale ee masaafada dheer.
Sida ay sheegtay Lockheed Martin, Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sidoo kale haysataa nidaamka difaaca ee Patriot Advanced Capability 3 (PAC-3), kaas oo awood u leh inuu ka hortago gantaallada masaafada dheer, gantaallada 'cruise'-ka, iyo diyaaradaha dagaalka.
Nidaamkan waxaa lagu yaqaannaa inuu isticmaalo raadaar horumarsan oo awood u leh inuu la socdo oo uu burburiyo weerarro badan oo isku mar dhacaya.
Marka laga soo tago inuu diyaar u yahay in la isticmaalo muddo gaaban gudaheed, nidaamka gantaallada ayaa leh awood uu kaga hortago weerarrada elektaroonigga ah.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Hammad Walid wuxuu sheegay in hubka loo isticmaalo nidaamyada PAC-2 iyo PAC-3 ay ku kacayaan malaayiin doollar.
Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sidoo kale isticmaashaa gantaallada lidka ku ah diyaaradaha ee nooca Oerlikon, waana nidaam sidoo kale laga arkay muuqaal ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga.
Sida uu sheegay cilmi-baaruhu, rasaasta 35mm ah ee ay isticmaalaan qoryahan lidka ku ah diyaaradaha ayaa ka jaban marka loo eego gantaallada nidaamka Patriot.
"Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in nidaamka difaaca Patriot loo isticmaalo wax ka qabashada khataraha waaweyn, sida gantaallada ama diyaaradaha waaweyn ee aan duuliyaha lahayn, halka qoryaha Oerlikon ee 35mm loo isticmaalo soo rididda diyaaradaha yaryar ee aan duuliyaha lahayn."
Hammad Walid wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in qoryaha Oerlikon ee 35mm laga isticmaalo Pakistan, isla markaana si guul leh loogu isticmaalay ka hortagga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Hindiya bishii Maajo ee sannadkii hore.
Caqabadaha xagga amniga ee haysta Sacuudiga
Andrew Davidson, oo ah falanqeeye ka tirsan joornaalka Geopolitical Affairs iyo sarkaal hore oo Mareykan ah oo ka soo shaqeeyay Bariga Dhexe, ayaa aaminsan in Sacuudi Carabiya ay awood u leedahay inay wax ka qabato khataraha iman kara, laakiin ay la kulmi karto khasaarooyin waaweyn haddii weerarradu sii socdaan muddo dheer ama ay yihiin kuwo ballaaran.
Isagoo soo xiganaya tirooyin ay daabacday Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Daraasaadka Istaraatiijiyadda (IISS) sannadkii 2025, wuxuu sheegay in Sacuudi Carabiya ay haysato 108 gantaal oo Patriot ah, laakiin "dagaalka lala galay Iiraan wuxuu muujinayaa in weli ay suurtagal tahay in la duqeeyo goobaha muhiimka ah."
Sida laga soo xigtay isaga, intii lagu jiray colaaddii dhoweyd, Sacuudi Carabiya waxaa lagu qasbay inay kheyraadkeeda amniga u jiheyso ilaalinta goobaha barakeysan ee diinta iyo sidoo kale magaalooyinka kale, saldhigyada militariga iyo kaabayaasha tamarta.
Andrew Davidson wuxuu sheegay in diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta meelaha qaarkood ay la macno tahay in kheyraadka loo isticmaali karo in lagu ilaaliyo meelaha kale ay xaddidan yihiin.
In kasta oo aan la garanayn xaaladda dhabta ah ee rasaasta iyo kaydka hubka ee Sacuudi Carabiya, haddana xaaladdu waxay soo bandhigaysaa walaac ah in dalka Bariga Dhexe uu sidoo kale la kulmi karo saameynta yaraanta nidaamyada difaaca gantaalada.

Weather alerts ranging between red, orange and yellow were issued for Telangana districts for Thursday (September 24, 2026)
| Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for five Telangana districts for Thursday (September 24, 2026). Eight districts were placed under orange alert.
Districts under red alert
According to IMDs latest bulletin, a red alert, indicating very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall was issued for isolated places in Kumaram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial, Jayashankar Bhupalapally, Mulugu and Bhadradri Kothagudem districts.
Districts under orange alert
An orange alert, indicating heavy to very heavy rainfall was issued for isolated places in Adilabad, Jagtial, Karimnagar, Peddapalli, Khammam, Mahabubabad, Warangal and Hanumakonda districts.
Districts under yellow alert
Additionally, a yellow alert, indicating heavy rainfall, was issued for Nirmal, Nizamabad, Rajanna Sircilla, Nalgonda, Suryapet, Jangaon, Siddipet, Yadadri Bhuvangiri, Mahabubnagar, Nagarkurnool, Wanaparthy and Jogulamba Gadwal districts.
Hyderabad weather forecast
Hyderabad city and its surrounding areas for the next 24 hours will see a generally cloudy sky. “Light to moderate rain or thundershowers accompanied with gusty winds are very likely to occur in the city. The maximum and minimum temperatures are likely to be around 30℃ and 22℃ respectively,” the bulletin said.

Cyclone alert in Odisha: Malkangiri steps up preparedness, rescue teams on standby
Updated On: 23 September, 2026 04:54 PM IST | Malkangiri | ANI
Odisha’s Malkangiri district is on red alert as an approaching cyclone is expected to bring heavy rain. Authorities have activated shelters, deployed 220 JCBs, mobilised ODRAF teams and barricaded vulnerable bridges as part of efforts to prevent casualties and speed up rescue operations
Listen to this article :

As Odisha's Malkangiri district braces for the impact of an approaching cyclone following a red alert, the district administration has ramped up disaster response measures, putting relief teams on standby and deploying heavy machinery to ensure "zero casualties".
Speaking to ANI on the districts preparedness, Malkangiri Collector Prathamesh Arvind Rajeshirke stated that heavy downpours are expected to intensify by Wednesday evening as the cyclone makes landfall, with rains likely continuing through Thursday morning.

Maharashtra is at present witnessing a 17% rainfall deficit as it has recorded 787.2 mm rainfall against a normal rainfall of 953.2 mm. Representational file image
| Photo Credit: PTI
As several parts of Maharashtra are facing a prolonged dry spell, with the government taking measures to tackle a drought-like situation, the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rainfall warning, forecasting heavy rainfall in Marathwada, Vidarbha, and Konkan, while issuing a yellow alert in Marathwada regions like Beed, Hingoli, Latur and others.
The yellow alert has been given in 39 districts, including the Marathwada and Vidarbha regions. A yellow alert was announced on September 23 for Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Gondia, Nagpur, Wardha, Washim, Nashik, Latur, Ratnagiri, and Satara, while an orange alert whas been issued for September 24 for Nagpur, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, and Yavatmal. For September 25, an orange alert has been issued for Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Gondia, and Bhandara.
Heavy rain accompanied by strong winds is expected in Latur, Dharashiv, Yavatmal, Nanded, Chandrapur, Nagpur, Gadchiroli and Gondia districts. Thunderstorms and rain are also forecast in Kolhapur, Sangli, Pune, Nashik, Satara, Solapur and Ahilyanagar districts.
IMD has forecasted “fairly widespread to widespread rainfall” over Konkan & Goa and Marathwada during September 23 and “isolated to scattered rainfall likely over Konkan & Goa and Marathwada from September 24 to 28, and Madhya Maharashtra from September 23-28. Strong Surface Winds likely over Madhya Maharashtra and Marathwada during September 24-25, and thunderstorms to be reported at isolated places over North Konkan and North Madhya Maharashtra.”
The Southwest monsoon is expected to withdraw from October 5. Maharashtra is at present witnessing a 17% rainfall deficit as it has recorded 787.2 mm rainfall against a normal rainfall of 953.2 mm. Several dams in the State have run dry, while farmers suffer crop loss due to the dry spell. The deficient rainfall in the State is being attributed to El Niño. Rainfall remained deficient in August and September.
A low-pressure area has formed over the Bay of Bengal and to intensify into a deep depression over the next 12 hours; wind speeds are likely to reach 75 kmph.
Published - September 23, 2026 01:54 pm IST
